title: Analog Read Serial
description: Wire a potentiometer to an analog input and watch its value stream into the Serial Monitor as you turn the knob.

steps.clip: Let's gather what you need: an Arduino Uno, a breadboard, a 10k potentiometer, and a few jumper wires.
Pick up the potentiometer and push all three legs into the breadboard, each in its own column.
hints: The middle leg is the wiper — its voltage is what changes when you turn the knob.
Give each leg its own column so they don't touch each other.

steps.clip: Run a wire from one of the potentiometer's outer legs to GND.
hints: Either outer leg works — they're interchangeable.
Black is the usual color for a ground wire.

steps.clip: Run a wire from the potentiometer's other outer leg to 5V.
hints: This is the outer leg you didn't just wire to GND.
Red is the usual color for a 5V wire.

steps.clip: Run a wire from the potentiometer's middle leg to pin A0.
hints: The middle leg is the wiper — this is the signal the Arduino will read.
Turning the knob changes the voltage on pin A0.

steps.clip: Upload the sketch, then open the Serial Monitor and watch the numbers change as you turn the knob.
